title: The entangled loop: Emotion, interference and hierarchy in the architecture of consciousness
title_zh: 纠缠回路：意识架构中的情感、干扰与层级
abstract: Why does consciousness feel like something, and why is experience unified rather than fragmented? We propose that these properties arise from an entangled trefoil of emotion, interference-based inference and hierarchical orchestration, shaped by the thermodynamic constraint that living systems must remain far from equilibrium using limited energy. Emotion compresses actions into valenced signals of what matters, while a pleasure cycle schedules competing biological needs through predictive wanting and satiety organised around the true hedonic outcome of liking. Hierarchical orchestrating regions integrate and broadcast information through interference between classical coupled oscillators, shaped by the spectral gaps of the connectome driven by long-range exceptions to local cortical wiring. The architecture of the Entangled Loop consists of three inseparable strands, each continually constraining the other two, with the one operator linking computational possibilities to the arrow of time and energetic cost of running them. Evidence suggests that the same three signatures emerge independently in large language models trained on human language, but as shadows of the generating architecture rather than evidence of consciousness. The trefoil predicts a distinctive human vulnerability because our abundance of rare long-range connections promotes more computation for less energy while making the architecture more fragile. Neuropsychiatric disorders could therefore arise from perturbations entering through any strand and propagating through the others, while the more robust architecture of other species may help explain why animal models reproduce human psychiatric disorders poorly. Sustaining and restoring flexible entanglement in the Entangled Loop may provide mechanistic routes towards flourishing.
abstract_zh: 意识为何具有主观体验，且体验为何是统一而非碎片化的？我们提出，这些特性源于由情感、基于干扰的推理与层级协调构成的纠缠三叶结，其形态受热力学约束塑造：生物系统必须在有限能量下维持远离平衡的状态。情感将行为压缩为具有价值的信号，标示何者重要，而快感循环则通过预测性渴求与以“真正享乐结局（喜悦）”为中心的满足感，安排竞争性生物需求。层级协调脑区通过经典耦合振荡器之间的干扰整合并广播信息，其形态由连接体的谱带隙以及远程例外对局部皮层布线的影响所塑造。纠缠回路的架构由三种不可分割的组成部分构成，它们彼此持续相互约束，唯一的算子将计算可能性与时间的箭头及运行它们所需的能量成本联系起来。证据表明，在人类语言上训练的大型语言模型中也会独立出现相同三个特征，但它们只是生成架构的“影子”，而非意识的证据。三叶结预测了一种特有的人类脆弱性：丰富的稀有远程连接使得以更少能量进行更多计算成为可能，但也使架构更加脆弱。因此，神经精神疾病可能源于通过任何组成部分进入并传播至其他部分的扰动，而其他物种更为稳健的架构或许有助于解释为何动物模型难以复制人类精神疾病。维持和恢复纠缠回路的灵活纠缠，可能为走向繁荣提供机制性路径。
